narration: Welcome to the Bronze Gallery, where we have a beautiful 13th‑century Chola bronze of the goddess Devi, accession number NM 58.3/9. This 68‑centimetre statue depicts Devi in the graceful tribhanga pose, with one hand lowered in a blessing gesture, typical of later Chola bronzes. Historically, such consort images were cast alongside the main deity and carried on palanquins during temple festivals, allowing devotees who could not enter the sanctum to receive the goddess’s presence. The National Museum acquired this piece as part of its Chola bronze collection, and it remains under the care of the Government of India, Ministry of Culture.
